items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: Mr. Pace here in Pensacola wanted us to come over here and play at Florida Town.

ctx.x: Why did you quit playing? Well, like I was about to say, music has been an avocation with me more than for steady fare. And I have been successful. Like I came here on, the boys had never been out on the road with Geordie. And Mr. Pace here in Pensacola wanted us to come over here and play at Florida Town. So the band came over here under the name of Harold Geordie. But when Dave Johnson, a lot of them saw the band, they said, well, that's Norman Brownlee's band from New Orleans. Well, the thing was, a lot of the…
Well, yeah, that's what we're here for.
